desc:
👻 LIVE BOSS: the Headless Pumpkin King! Candy, pumpkin boxes, spooky thieves and x2 MONEY all week!

😴 You fell asleep... and a thief just grabbed your box! WAKE UP and catch him!

🏃 Train on treadmills to get FASTER
📦 Catch the thieves before they escape with your boxes
😃 Open boxes to get Verities that make money for you
🌋 Unlock 5 worlds: Green, Lava, Ice, Candy and Space
✨ Find rare mutations: Gold, Diamond, Rainbow and more!
🔁 Rebirth to multiply your money
⏰ A new event every 15 minutes: x2 Luck, x2 Money, x2 Speed and meteors!
💤 Your Verities keep earning even while you're offline!

👥 Play with friends: +10% money for each friend (up to +50%)
⭐ Roblox Premium players get +15% money

🎁 CODES: HALLOWEEN (NEW!) • RELEASE • VERITY • THANKYOU
